d: Ash-brown hair is styled in a messy high ponytail with choppy bangs and loose strands framing the face. Sharp, narrow crimson eyes carry a playful, mischievous expression on a youthful face. The build is slender with a toned midriff, dressed in a cropped white and soft-pink hoodie over a black under-layer, paired with tight black leggings featuring white stripes and white athletic sneakers with pink laces. Signature details include a blue utility belt with attached black pouches adorned with pink bows, a small star tattoo on the lower abdomen, and a wrench tucked into a side holster.
